commons_title: File:U.S. Marines embark heavy equipment to Romania for NATO-led exercise 151130-M-TV331-088.jpg
description:
U.S. Marines with the Combined Arms Company, Black Sea Rotational Force load tanks, artillery and light-armored vehicles onto rail cars at Zimnitsa Rail Yard, Bulgaria, Nov. 30, 2015, to transport the heavy equipment to Smardan Training Area, Romania, for participation in Exercise Platinum Lynx 16-2. The NATO-led exercise will begin Monday, Dec. 7 and is a designed to build partner capacity in a combat environment, focusing on mechanized integration and indirect fire techniques. (U.S. Marine Corps photo by Cpl. Justin T. Updegraff/ Released)
Unit: U.S. Marine Corps Forces Europe and Africa
creator: Cpl. Justin Updegraff
